il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s01: The next day Giada has breakfast again in the kitchen, with her father reading his phone.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s02: Outside it rains gently on Trento; inside everything is warm and ordinary.

il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s06: No face, no square, no Elsa.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s07: Only the mark that someone wanted to erase a real place.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s10: In her head she puts a caption she does not write under the image.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s12: It does not exist on the map.

il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s31: I have a photo of the sign.

il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s36: The number is clear, written in a hurry.

il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s44: Maybe a book later, or a summer later, that number will be useful.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s45: Now it serves to remember that exit is not a forced rescue.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s46: Giada puts the phone on the table and helps her father with the dishes.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s47: They talk about shopping, work, a short trip to the mountains.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s48: Collevento does not occupy every sentence; it must not.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s49: It remains as a photo and a word: it existed.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s50: In the evening Giada looks at the image one more time.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s51: The black line on the name no longer scares her as a riddle.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s52: It gives her respect as a fact.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s53: Someone erased a village on paper.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s55: She passed through, said no, and left at dawn.

il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s60: Before sleeping she writes three lines in the phone notes.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s61: The village does not exist on the map.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s65: The rain continues on Trento, ordinary.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s66: In the pocket of the washed pants, Neri's number stays folded and quiet.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s68: Ready, if one day the question arrives in the right voice.

il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s70: Only with a photo, a kitchen, and a true word.

il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s73: She will not publish it and will not use it as proof for anyone.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s74: It is a memory with a boundary, not a weapon.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s75: Her father makes coffee and asks if she wants eggs.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s77: They eat without returning at once to Collevento.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s78: Sometimes respect is also this: not repeating the story at every meal.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s79: Giada checks contacts: Neri is there, silent.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s81: If one day he writes after asking his people, she will answer.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s82: If he does not write, the number will remain as an unforced possibility.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s83: Outside the rain lightens; the roofs shine.

il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s85: A crossing-out does not remove existence from things; it only removes the official list.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s86: She saw the place, said no, and left.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s87: Summer can continue without her solving the village.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s88: The village did not ask for a savior.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s89: It asked, at times, for a girl to put at the center.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s90: Giada refused the center and kept the photo.
il-villaggio-che-non-esiste-24:s92: And she still exists, with her own name, in Trento.
